SELECT DISTINCT Code, len(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID) SegmentLength, (case when len(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID)=1 then 1 when len(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID)=4 then 2 when len(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID)=7 then 3 when len(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID)=10 then 4 when len(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID)=13 then 5 when len(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID)=18 then 6 end ) SegmentNo, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, SUM(Debit) AS Debit, SUM(Credit) AS Credit, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag ,MonthNo,Month_Name FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, 0 AS Debit, 0 AS Credit ,'' as Month_Name ,'' as MonthNo ,left(CodeCombinationID,5) as Code
FROM GL_CodeCombinationDetail WHERE GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartofAccountID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1 UNION ALL
SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Debit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Credit ,datename(month, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as Month_Name ,month(GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as MonthNo ,left(CodeCombinationID,5) as Code FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartofAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID
AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate AND @ToDate
AND GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
AND IsNull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null
Group By GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GL_TransactionHeader.Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.Amount, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.SerialNo,GL_TransactionDetail.Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.SerialNo ,GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID ,GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID
) Tab_COA_Tran1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID where GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1 AND (GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag = null OR null IS NULL)
GROUP BY GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive,Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag ,MonthNo,Month_Name,Code
) as tab group by code,AccountTypeID ,MonthNo,Month_Name order by code,MonthNo
